pairs.difference: A pushes the ball's red and blue panels to near-black groups with white streak highlights and a black sliver of contact shadow, while the sand breaks into speckled light and mid fragments. Its mean of 0.747 is just over the real range. B holds large calm groups: pale sand, a dark blue panel rolling softly into a broad mid-value shadow, and gentle contrast inside the ball.
pairs.fix: Keep the sand as one calm light shape with no speckled ripples. Let the dark ball panels shade softly with one small highlight each.

pairs.difference: B scatters the card into many mid-value pieces: brick wall, shelf brackets, cans, a ball, a flag and five bright bulbs, with no large dark mass. A sits on a broad dark red field with a black band along the bottom, so the white target rings are the single light shape. Its lightness gap of 0.159 is at the edge of the real range.
pairs.fix: Remove the extra props. Put the target and bear against one large deep-red dark area, and make the wall and the strip under the shelf much darker.

pairs.difference: A is very high key (0.77, above the real 0.707). White ceiling, sun patches, wall stripes and cushions all reach the same light level as the white unit, so the hero has no clean light-on-mid edge and the groups are broken up. B keeps the unit as the one white shape on a mid-value wall, with a darker top-left corner. It is also over range, at 0.729, but the grouping is simpler.
pairs.fix: Make the wall one even mid-dark green and remove the sun patches and bright furniture, so the white air conditioner is the only very light shape on the card.

pairs.difference: A is bright throughout: sand near white, water lifted to a mid-light glow around the lid, and hard white highlights on the gold rims. The whole card stays lit, with the dark only inside the chest panels. B has a dark water field with lighter patches up top, a chest in the mid values, and the lower ground falling to dark. The light is restrained and the card has a real dark mass.
pairs.fix: Darken the water toward the corners and lower the sand from near white to a warm mid-light tone. Keep the brightest light on the gold trim only.

pairs.difference: A's hat is a huge white shape against a near-black brim, with wall and floor mid-dark. The contrast is pushed to 0.204, above the real top of 0.195, and the white-to-black jump inside the hero is hard. B is a low-key card (0.50, below the real range) with a darker wall and a corner of light, but the white crown rolls gently into grey along its right side.
pairs.fix: Let the white crown fall off into soft grey on the shadow side. Lift the navy brim slightly so it is not near black against pure white.

pairs.difference: A has a tight bright halo hugging the booth, plus a near-white floor and scattered light specks along the silhouette. Its vignette of -0.061 is outside the real range of -0.010 to 0.086. B has a broad soft light behind the booth with darker corners (0.05) and a mid-value floor, and the dark red booth reads as one solid mass.
pairs.fix: Replace the glow hugging the booth with a wide soft light on the wall. Darken the corners and bring the floor down to a mid green.

pairs.difference: A's gloves are glossy, with several separate white hot spots on each glove and hard black cuffs on a clean floor group. B has matte gloves with one soft highlight each and a large dark pool between them. B's vignette of -0.103 falls outside the real range, which argues the other way, so this is a weak call based on the highlight pattern.
pairs.fix: Reduce each glove to one soft broad highlight and let the red roll gently into shadow, without several small white spots.

pairs.difference: A has a large bright magenta bloom right behind the fins, which shows in the lens as a mid-value blob tracing their outline. The vignette of 0.1 is strong and the fin bodies stay in soft mid-lights. B has a fainter broken ring in the background, with white fin faces and black foot pockets and tips, so the hero separates by its own value range.
pairs.fix: Remove the glow that follows the fins. Keep the background as even dark purple rings and put the deepest darks in the foot openings.

pairs.difference: B breaks into small value pieces: palm, flower, rocks, clouds, foam, starfish, and caustic cells all over the water, so the dock has no ground to sit on. Its vignette of -0.093 is outside the real range because the corners are bright. A has one big dark water mass with a light sand strip at the top, and the dock and ring read clearly against it, with deep accents under the posts.
pairs.fix: Remove the palm, flowers and starfish. Make the water one large deep shape with few ripples, and keep the dark accents under the dock.

pairs.difference: B's leaves carry hard white highlight patches against dark fronds, the coconuts drop to near black, and the corners are deep, which gives punchy local contrast across a big hero. A is gentler: leaves and magenta sit close in value, with the darker notes at the frond centre. Its rms of 0.111 is slightly below real, which is a point against A and makes this call weaker.
pairs.fix: Soften the highlights on the fronds into gradual light green and avoid white patches. Lower the contrast inside the leaves.

pairs.difference: A's locker has hard black inside the shelves, with bright white and pure-colour shoes and books popping out of it. The whole interior is high contrast against an evenly lit orange body. B is softer: a mid-value locker, smaller objects, and a large dark cast shadow on the wall that gives a bold dark group. B's vignette of -0.055 is out of range, so confidence stays low.
pairs.fix: Ease the interior from black to a deep warm brown and lower the contrast on the shoes and books so they do not outshine the locker.

pairs.difference: A is high key, with a white floor, a white-lit platform, and pale-lit green and yellow, at 0.743 above the real 0.738. The only dark area in the structure is the blue ladder, and the slide is broken up by small water highlights. B holds bold groups: a dark underside of the slide, a mid wall with light waves, and a light floor.
pairs.fix: Bring the floor tiles down to a light mid tone and give the slide a large dark underside, so the hero has one solid shadow shape.

pairs.difference: B has a large player and earbuds near white, with magenta rings lifted around them. The hero is almost entirely in the top two value levels with strong bright rims, and little stays in the middle. A has a smaller player mostly in mid-light, with dark and mid rings kept as clean simple bands, and the hero stays quieter. Both exceed the real lightness gap.
pairs.fix: Lower the player body to a warm mid-light orange and darken the bright glow behind it, keeping the background rings as flat bands.

pairs.difference: B glows evenly: a bright green field, a mid band around the envelope, and pale envelope and photos. Its mean of 0.795 is above range and its rms of 0.084 below, so the card is washed toward light and the corners are barely dark. A has clear dark green corners (vignette 0.101), a mid centre, and a white envelope that reads as one light shape, with the dark mass inside the photo.
pairs.fix: Deepen the green toward the corners and remove the bright glow behind the envelope, so the pale envelope stands out against a darker field.

pairs.difference: B's bright striped wall reaches white in the lens and competes with the fruit. Fruit and wall edges break up along the top of the bowl, and the wood below is streaky and noisy, for a mean of 0.75 above the real range. A has an even mid-value wood field and a clear dark plate shadow. Its rms of 0.115 is a touch low, but the groups are simpler.
pairs.fix: Replace the bright stripes with one even mid-value warm background, so the fruit is the only area with strong light and dark.

pairs.difference: A is lit throughout: a near-white wall, pale steps, and many small mid-value leaves around a mid-blue door, and the lamp, pot and bush add more scattered pieces. B has one heavy dark door and dark vine mass with a small light strip at lower right. The flowers are the only lights, so the dark grouping is much bolder, though at 0.552 it sits at the low edge of the real range.
pairs.fix: Darken the wall to a warm mid tone, remove the lamp, pot and bush, and let the door and leaves form one large dark shape with the wreath as the light centre.

pattern: Generated cards stay lit everywhere: a lifted key, near-white grounds and walls, and a glow or bright band tracing the hero's outline, with shallow dark corners. Value breaks into many small pieces from extra props, speckled ground and scattered highlights instead of a few big light, mid and dark masses. Inside the hero the contrast runs hard, with white hot spots next to near-black and little roll-off. Real cards commit to one large dark or mid field, keep the darkest accents in tight contact areas, and let the hero's highlights fall off gently.
